notes.title: Update 1.1.1 – NERFING WTF BOSS
notes.notes:
Wtf Boss

Reduced HP from 7,250 to 7,000.
Reduced projectile damage from 25 to 20.
Reduced projectile velocity from 115 to 113.
Reduced movement speed from 94 to 92.
Reduced punch charge speed from 113 to 105.
Increased attack delay after teleport from 0.54 (Rage mode: 0.48) to 0.58 (Rage mode: 0.53).

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE - BALANCING THINGS
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231366/408ddb1734816cb9350c63f50c7cf2234fa9d8dd.gif

Helloooooooooo🔫🤨

Today, I bring you some new and interesting updates!

Updated:

 Reduced stamina consumption.
 Increased attack cooldown for ranged enemies.
 Increased trigger delay for arrow traps.
Reduced damage from all traps.


Added:

 New animation for ranged enemies.
 New stomp effect for melee enemies.
